text_block_list.text:
While walking down the hallway, I hear

high-pitched laughter from the studio,
where a
dance lesson is being held...
Ohoho! I'm not done yet!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
At the upcoming ball, I'll showcase a
first-rate
dance worthy of the name
King!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: HOLD IT!
There's no ball like a masquerade, and that means masks! And that means it's El time!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: El?! Where did you come fr—
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Miss King... No, just King! I challenge
you to a
battle!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I swear on my Latina blood that my
dancing will
put you to shame!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Put me to shame? Why exactly are you

challenging me, I wonder?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And to a dance battle, no less. I assume
that's not
your dancing outfit.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
This is my signature racewear, y'know?
The muy
caliente Condor Brawler outfit.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Ohoho! Enough with your jesting. Go
and clamber
into a ring somewhere.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
My time is too precious for such silliness.
Now, if
you'll allow me to continue with
my lesson.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
"Ladies compete not by combat, but
through
dance."
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...Those were the words spoken by a
certain
first-rate individual when I had a
dance battle
with her.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Is... is that so?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: I was dressed like this, and she had nooo problem battling me.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Or should I say, she was secure enough
in her
first-rateness that she could
accept it.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: Secure... in her first-rateness?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: But I guess I can't expect you to be that secure, King.
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
And I always thought you were
first-rate... I'm
disappointed!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text: What?! Now, hold it right there!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Very well, I'll show you just how secure
in my
first-rateness I am!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ay! That's the way!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
You there, come judge our battle! And
don't
freeze up when it comes time to
pick a winner!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Overwhelmed by her sheer intensity, I
nod in
agreement before I can help
myself

Classical and Latin music starts to play

simultaneously as the dance battle
begins.

Grrr! I won't let you call me a snow
monkey again!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
I have no idea what you're alluding to,
but... you
just don't back down, do you?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
TAKE THAAAT!
HYAAAH!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса and Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The sun sets, but the two show no signs
of
stopping. I'm not sure how a battle of
waltz and
mambo could come to a
natural conclusion in the
first place...
There's only one way to wrap this up!
There's only one way to wrap this up!
Excuse me? What has gotten into you?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: I suddenly got the urge to dance too!

text_block_list.text:
Hehe! Looks as if my passion has ignited
your
dancing spirit!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
...King. I see now that you're worthy of
calling
yourself "first-rate."
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
Hmph! B-but of course! I suppose I can

acknowledge that zeal of yours as well.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Damn right! Do you two have any idea
what time
it is?!
text_block_list.name: Хиши Амадзон

text_block_list.text: Gyah! Hishiama!
text_block_list.name: Эль Кондор Паса

text_block_list.text:
While I appreciate your enthusiasm,
please do
not cause me undue concern.
text_block_list.name: Фудзи Кисэки

text_block_list.text: Fuji!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
My deepest apologies. I'll return to the
dorm right
away.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
The blistering dance battle comes to an
end with
the two dancers acknowledging
each other's
passion for dance.

And so the dance battle ends in a draw
as the two
dancers wobble back to their
respective dorms,
accompanied by their
dorm leaders.
